trials.name: conservative
trials.purpose: Unchanged original Conservative baseline; smoother neighborhood and larger, denser clusters.

trials.name: fine_grained
trials.purpose: Keep Initial UMAP fixed; relax HDBSCAN size and density requirements to test smaller/local policy clusters and fragmentation.

trials.name: coarse_grained
trials.purpose: Keep Conservative UMAP fixed; require larger and denser HDBSCAN clusters to test broad themes, merging, and exclusion of rare subjects.

selection_policy: Assess coherence, diversity, coverage, aligned seed stability, temporal robustness and concentration jointly. Reject degenerate or strongly fragmented solutions even when a single metric is high. Prefer defensible trade-offs; recommendations are provisional until legal-expert review. No weighted composite score or automatic highest-score winner.
interpretation: Joint sensitivity experiment on the unchanged full eligible cleaned-TXT corpus. Seeds vary UMAP while lexical SVD and frozen Legal-BERT representations remain fixed, matching the original stability design. All configurations refit; earlier clustering metrics are not reused. Optional identity-validated embedding reuse is explicitly timed and disclosed. No expert ratings or held-out generalization claims.
